description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 U6, the column twin of t5123-deleted-cell-delete-row): how a deleted single cell prints, on another sheet and on its own, after delete_column C on S. S!B4:D4 hold 4,1,2; on S, A6 =C4 and A7 =$C$4 sit in a column that stays, E6 =C4 and E7 =$C$4 in a column that moves left. Sheet F holds A1 =S!C4, A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =S!$C$4+1, A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!C4,S!D4) (a deleted cell beside a live one), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), then the value and FORMULATEXT of S!A6 (A7, A8), S!A7 (A9, A10), S!E6 (A11, A12) and S!E7 (A13, A14); the references to E6 and E7 follow the moved cells.
